title: 7828 British Subject involved in a fight with a Japanese subject

page_data.en:
Dixwell Road 7828
13 / 3 / 37
12th. Mar. 37.

British subject involved in a fight with Japanese subject.

and Inspector Watson.

Sir,

At 5.15.a.m. 12-3-37, a telephone message was received from the North Szechuen Road Station, S.C.G.P.B. reporting a British subject detained there having been involved in a fight with a Japanese in the Venus Cafe, Jukong Road and requesting that someone be sent to take him over. Inspector Watson attended and brought to this Station one named Samuel George Shaw, British subject of Japanese extraction, age 28, M/ship-owner residing at No. 3/195 Route Ghisi.

At 5.30.a.m. 12-3-37, J.P.C. 92 also brought to the Station a Japanese named Shigeo Takeda, age 35, dancing instructor, residing at No.131 Darroch Road whom he found on North Szechuen Road near Jukong Road bleeding profusely from his right hand, and who on being taken to the Poo Ming Hospital was certified by the Doctor to be suffering from "Lacerated wounds of the right hand, not serious".

（印：... 12 ...）

Questioned by D. S. Craig, Japanese detectives and the undersigned Shaw stated that he was leaving the Venus Cafe with two gentlemen and a lady friend when he accidentally bumped into Takeda and tramped on his foot, the latter insisting that it was done intentionally and demanding an apology with the result that several blows were struck until the parties were separated by a Russian witness named Nickolay Nickolaevich Chernecoleff and Mr. Levy, proprietor of the Venus Cafe. Mr. Shaw stated he then got into his M/car, Licence No.1216, Chinese Lic. No.3611, when Takeda jumped on the running board and again demanded an apology. Failing to get this he deliberately smashed his fist through the near side front glass panel sustaining the injuries as stated above. This is corroborated by the Russian witness. Mr. ...

（批：... 12/3/37.）
page_data.zh:
狄思威路 7828
1937年3月13日
1937年3月12日。

一名英籍人士卷入与一名日籍人士的斗殴事件。

及沃森巡官。

先生：

1937年3月12日凌晨5时15分，接四川北路巡捕房（S.C.G.P.B.）电话报告，称一名英籍人士因在掘孔路维纳斯咖啡馆（Venus Cafe）与一名日本人发生斗殴而被拘押于该处，请求派人将其接管。沃森巡官前往处理，并将一名名为塞缪尔·乔治·肖（Samuel George Shaw）的英籍人士带至本巡捕房。该人系日裔，28岁，职业为船东，居住于祁齐路（Route Ghisi）3/195号。

1937年3月12日凌晨5时30分，日本警视厅（J.P.C.）第92号警员也将一名名为武田茂雄（Shigeo Takeda）的日籍人士带至本巡捕房。该人35岁，职业为舞蹈教师，居住于达罗克路（Darroch Road）131号。警员在四川北路近掘孔路处发现他时，其右手大量出血。经送往宝明医院（Poo Ming Hospital）后，医生诊断证明其伤势为“右手撕裂伤，非重伤”。

（印：... 12 ...）

经D. S. Craig、日本侦探及具结人讯问，肖陈述称，当时他正与两位绅士及一位女性友人离开维纳斯咖啡馆，不慎撞到武田并踩到其脚。武田坚称此举是故意的，并要求道歉，导致双方互殴数拳，直至被一名名为尼古拉·尼古拉耶维奇·切尔内科列夫（Nickolay Nickolaevich Chernecoleff）的俄国目击者及维纳斯咖啡馆老板利维（Levy）先生拉开。肖先生称，随后他进入其汽车（牌照号1216，中国牌照号3611），此时武田跳上脚踏板，再次要求道歉。因未获道歉，武田故意用拳头击碎近侧前窗玻璃面板，从而导致上述伤势。此情节得到该俄国目击者证实。____ 先生

（批：... 1937年3月12日。）

page_data.en:
Continued.

then got down from the car and was arrested by Chinese Constables
No. 2478 and 4684 of the S. C. G. P. B. and taken to the North
Szechuen Road Station, his car and friend meanwhile, being
driven away by Mr. Shaw's chauffeur.
    Takeda's statement is substantially the same but the
Japanese insists that Mr. Shaw was entirely to blame for the
incident although he admits he does not know whether the first
collision was intentional or not but considered he was entitled
to an apology and which not being forth-coming made him take the
action he did. After these enquiries had been completed neither
party wished to take any further action and the incident was
amicably settled by Shaw apologising to Takeda and the latter
offering to pay for the damage done to the window of the car.
This was witnessed by Japanese Consular detective G. Miyao and
Interpreter S. V. Liu of the S. C. G. P. B. and the Japanese manager
of the Venus Cafe Mr. S. Sato. All concerned then left the
Station at 8.30. a. m. 12-3-37.

                                            I am, Sir,
                                        Your obedient servant,
                                        *Jarralson*
                                            Inspector.
                                            Officer i/c

D. O. "C"
Special Branch.

*G. [signature]* *shes.*
page_data.zh:
续。

随后下车，被四川北路巡捕房（S. C. G. P. B.）第2478号和4684号华捕逮捕，并带往四川北路巡捕房，其汽车及朋友则由肖先生的司机驾车离去。
    武田的陈述大体相同，但该日本人坚持认为肖先生应对此事负全部责任，尽管他承认不知道第一次碰撞是否为故意，但他认为自己有权获得道歉，因未获道歉才采取了上述行动。问询结束后，双方均无意采取进一步行动，事件通过肖向武田道歉以及后者提出赔偿汽车窗户损坏费用而友好解决。日本领事馆侦探G. Miyao、四川北路巡捕房翻译刘S. V.（S. V. Liu）以及维纳斯咖啡馆日方经理佐藤S. S.（S. Sato）先生见证了这一过程。所有相关人员随后于1937年3月12日上午8时30分离开巡捕房。

                                            此致，
                                        您顺从的仆人，
                                        *贾拉尔森*
                                            巡官。
                                            主管警官

C区警务总监
特别科。

*G. [签名]* *shes.*
